refined_prompt: Full-body flat 2D vector character design of a young energetic student mascot representing an urban school, slightly off-center, dynamic pose mid-stride. Round friendly face with simple geometric features, big teal (#4ecdc4) eyes, wide grin. Wearing an oversized hoodie in muted grey-lavender (#c8c7ce) printed with a flat geometric school building silhouette across the chest in deep near-black (#2d2d2d).
